issues.title: Ingest Dallas County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $8,541,856 across 30 funds. The largest: County General ($4,558,020), Road ($1,554,578), Solid Waste ($1,272,071). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile County General
issues.detail: Printed grand total is $4,558,019.91; the department totals listed add to $4,558,099.91. The $80 gap matches Equalization Board, whose printed total is $80 more than its own lines. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.

issues.title: Reconcile Jail (County General)
issues.detail: Printed total is $1,617,676.05; the categories listed add to $1,617,716.05. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.

issues.title: Reconcile Equalization Board (County General)
issues.detail: Printed total is $103,199.00; the categories listed add to $103,119.00. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
